links.outcome: Subgroup AUROC of violence prediction by sex, race, ethnicity, age, and mental health flag
links.effect: Subgroup AUROCs were high across sex, race, ethnicity, and age, but lower among patients with a documented mental health flag.
links.quote: Subgroup AUROCs were high across sex, race, ethnicity, and age, with lower performance among patients with a documented mental health flag.

unlisted_practices: Summarizing clinical notes with LLMs before risk classification (general vs clinician-entity-guided summaries)
Fine-tuning LLMs versus zero-shot prompting for risk prediction
Anchoring risk scoring in long-context discriminative models and using LLMs only for clinician-facing summaries or rationales

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates model architectures and feature preprocessing strategies (summarization vs raw text) for predicting inpatient violence, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or operational safeguard.
